name: Daily Standup
description: Time-boxed daily updates for engineering/product teams.
description_it: Aggiornamento quotidiano a tempo per team di sviluppo e prodotto.

sections.title: Date
sections.instruction: Meeting date only if stated in the transcript, otherwise 'Not stated'

sections.title: Attendees
sections.instruction: Names of the people present as they appear in the transcript; generic labels such as 'Speaker A' are not names

sections.title: Yesterday
sections.instruction: Work each person reported as completed (short bullets)

sections.title: Today
sections.instruction: Work each person plans for today (short bullets)

sections.title: Blockers
sections.instruction: Impediments raised, with owner and impact only if stated

sections.title: Notes
sections.instruction: Announcements or quick notes, if any
